digest.component_or_area: Jira family seam (Cloud + Data Center backends)
propositions: Jira Data Center deployments cannot be reconciled because rebar's adapter is Cloud-only and the two platforms diverge on REST version, auth mechanism, and user identity model
PR #120's forked adapter creates dependency-inverted private imports and duplicates shared field maps, making unavoidable drift between two independent implementations
Location-pinned modules loaded by filename at runtime cannot be relocated without teaching the dynamic loader the new path and rewriting every mock.patch site in the test suite

The Jira family shares single implementations of field maps, sanitizers, and link relations through a new jira_family sub-layer, with pluggable contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) for platform-specific variation
DC transport requires TLS by default with explicit allow_insecure override, reads PAT from environment only, and never disables certificate verification
